annotations.title: Drug inactive ingredients and allergen screen

description: Drug inactive ingredients and allergen screen — Inactive ingredients (excipients) for every manufacturer of a drug, from FDA structured product labels (OTC inactive-ingredient sections and Rx label descriptions). Flags lactose, milk protein, gluten/wheat, gelatin, soy, peanut, corn, dyes (incl. tartrazine), sulfites, aspartame, sugars, PEG, parabens, titanium dioxide, talc, propylene glycol, ethanol and more; optional avoid= (comma list of groups or any ingredient word, e.g. avoid=lactose,dyes) returns which products are free of them. Also the most common excipients across products. Optional limit= (default 25, max 100). Not medical advice; confirm with a pharmacist. Price: $0.004 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: fda_excipients
